Let me chronologically go through the conversation to capture all important details. 1. **Session start**: This is a continuation session from a previous conversation that ran out of context. The previous session summary was provided, covering extensive work on jaimeibrahim.com including domain transfer, image pipeline, content updates, and more. 2. **First task - Add Vimeo video URLs**: The conversation starts with context from previously read files (page.tsx, projects.ts, types.ts, CaseStudySection.tsx, images.ts). The assistant continued from where the previous session left off, adding Vimeo video URLs to 4 projects: - GLG Explainer: `https://player.vimeo.com/video/910157740` - TIAA: `https://player.vimeo.com/video/910195637` - Bloomberg: `https://player.vimeo.com/video/910191569` - Opera: `https://player.vimeo.com/video/910179983` Also downloaded Vimeo thumbnails for all 5 video projects and created opera hero image from its Vimeo thumbnail. Committed and deployed preview. 3. **User: "deploy to production"** - Deployed to production via `npx vercel --prod`. Note the Vercel deploy workflow requires temporarily changing git author email to `jomar.ibrahim@gmail.com` then restoring to `joseph@josephibrahim.com`. 4. **User: "there are alot of empty windows..."** - User reported empty placeholder image boxes on project detail pages like glg-video. The fix was: - Removed the 4-placeholder fallback from `page.tsx` (lines 136-147) replacing with `null` - Removed placeholder fallback from `CaseStudySection.tsx` - Cleaned up unused imports (PlaceholderImage from CaseStudySection, removed color prop) - Committed and deployed to production. 5. **User: "/creative look at thumbnails..."** - User invoked the creative skill and asked to adjust hero images for "The Year Ahead", "TIAA", and "Bloomberg Video Installation" to be more aesthetically pleasing. Deep visual review of all images: - Examined all 14 year-ahead images, 9 tiaa images, 4 bloomberg images - **Year Ahead**: Swapped from flat logo lockup (`TYA_2500logo.jpg`) to collateral mockup detail-06 (`TYA_invite_mockup_web.jpg`) - "OWN THE YEAR AHEAD" bold typography - **TIAA**: Swapped from distant conference room (`heritagewall_insitu_big.jpg`) to colorful timeline close-crop detail-03 (`heritagewall_1a.jpg`) - vibrant colored frames - **Bloomberg**: Swapped from dim lobby photo (`bigvideo_screens.jpg`) to "BIG" storyboard grid detail-01 (`bigvideo_storyboard.jpg`) - vibrant pink-to-gold gradient - Updated `scripts/optimize-images.mjs` hero entries for future pipeline runs 6. **User: "remove the underlines on the main navigation"** - This came while working on hero swaps. Fixed by: - Removed `.underline`, `.underlineActive`, `.navLink:hover .underline` CSS rules from Nav.module.css - Removed `` underline elements from Nav.tsx - Added `.navLinkActive` and `.navLink:hover` color-based states instead - Added `text-decoration: none` to `.navLink` - Committed both hero swaps and nav fix together, deployed to production. 7. **User: "/insights"** - Generated usage insights report. 8. **User: "look over site and suggest improvements"** - Did comprehensive site review: - Fetched all major pages via WebFetch - Read key component files - Created detailed improvement matrix with HIGH/MEDIUM/LOW priority items - HIGH: (1) Placeholder article text, (2) No OG image, (3) unused-concepts has no images, (4) Non-functional footer email 9. **User: "fix all the high priority items"** - Implemented all 4 fixes: - **Articles**: Created `src/lib/article-content.ts` with real article content for all 4 articles (brand-systems, fractional-cd, visual-storytelling, design-leadership). Updated `thoughts/[slug]/page.tsx` to use real content. - **OG Image**: Created `src/app/opengraph-image.tsx` using Next.js edge runtime ImageResponse API. Removed static og-image.jpg reference from layout.tsx metadata. - **unused-concepts**: Removed from `GRID_ROWS_ALL` in projects.ts, replaced with glg-explainer as a hero row - **Footer email**: Changed `hello@jaimeibrahim.com` to LinkedIn contact link in Footer.tsx - Built, committed, and deployed to production successfully. Key patterns to note: - Vercel deploy requires author email swap: `git config user.email "jomar.ibrahim@gmail.com"` before commit/deploy, then restore to `joseph@josephibrahim.com` after - Image manifest auto-generation via `scripts/generate-image-manifest.mjs` - Build verification before every deploy with `npm run build` - Git push to origin, then `npx vercel --prod` for production deploys 1. Primary Request and Intent: The user is building **jaimeibrahim.com**, a portfolio site for Jaime Ibrahim (Brand Design Director), using Next.js 16 on Vercel. The domain is transferring from Squarespace to Vercel. This session continued from a previous conversation and covered: - Adding Vimeo video embeds to 4 remaining projects (GLG Explainer, TIAA, Bloomberg, Met Opera) - Deploying to production multiple times - Removing empty placeholder image boxes from project detail pages - Swapping hero images for 3 projects (Year Ahead, TIAA, Bloomberg) to more aesthetically pleasing alternatives - Removing underlines from the main navigation - Comprehensive site review with improvement matrix - Fixing all 4 high-priority issues: placeholder article text, missing OG image, broken unused-concepts project, non-functional footer email 2. Key Technical Concepts: - **Next.js 16 App Router** with static generation (`generateStaticParams`) - **Vercel CLI deployment** requiring git author email match (`jomar.ibrahim@gmail.com` for Vercel, `joseph@josephibrahim.com` for normal dev) - **next/image** with natural aspect ratios on detail pages, `object-fit: cover` on grid cards - **Vimeo embed** via responsive 16:9 iframe (`paddingBottom: "56.25%"`) - **Auto-generated image manifest** (`scripts/generate-image-manifest.mjs` → `src/lib/image-manifest.ts`) - **Sharp-based image pipeline** (`scripts/optimize-images.mjs`) for source→optimized JPEG - **Next.js opengraph-image route** using edge runtime `ImageResponse` API - **CSS Modules** for component styling with CSS custom properties for design tokens - **Vimeo oEmbed API** for downloading video thumbnails as hero images 3.
